title: Independent verification: corroborate the CK all-dyadic forest floor without packed cost lanes (no new kappa)
body:
This additive research package independently corroborates Adam Gall's
[PR1220](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1220), discovered
during final overlap refresh. It claims neither a new mathematical frontier
nor additional coefficient-domain coverage. Two separately written scalar
checkers avoid its packed cost-lane arithmetic and reproduce all 13,501,152
ordered coefficient/target-pair prices, the same 63 minimum nonunit margin,
941 root-improving nonunit edges, and the retained 16,364 scalar-component floor.

Both implementations agree on the full ordered census digest
`8419c238a791375dd846ba7558aeea9185af8b776f148731c377ad21fe311e6d`.
A Fraction/bit-count census and a separately parsed literal-Horner/sign-normalized
census use Kruskal and Prim respectively, with all 12,544 cycle inequalities.
The source-specific finite result is combined with the credited PR961 tail
and same-parent forest exchange proof. No PR1220 executable was consumed.
Its immutable receipt matches the domain, extrema, witnesses and floor.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.10+ standard library:

```sh
python -I -B research/ck-dyadic-forest-seed22/verify.py
python -I -O -B research/ck-dyadic-forest-seed22/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_CK_DYADIC_FOREST cases=13501152 minimum_margin=63 floor=16364 no_new_kappa`.

Validation on Windows CPython 3.12.10: complete primary+independent replay,
9 focused tests with meaningful negative controls, inherited CK arbitrary-input
boundary checker in both orientations, selected-record integrity at the base,
minimal relocation without Git and with equivalent gzip recompression,
whitespace and clean-application checks. No runtime speedup is claimed.
Full repository/cold supplier suites, fresh physical/global admission,
hosted CI and Lean were not run.

Exact base `007664306fff84fbb1c9a1b4053b69f439764034`.
Final checked main `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f` retains both source inputs unchanged.
Only the new research package is added. `upstream/` and the selected frontier
are untouched. The claim, source heads/hashes, certificate, proof, execution
scope and overlap record are included. OS assignment seed22, complex track.

The result fixes the historical CK matrix, one-parent acyclic schedule,
separate preparation/restoration and independent original binary-Horner
lowering. No general circuit optimum, improved kappa or full multiplication
theorem is claimed. All inherited all-size/compiler, realization/hosting,
precision/tape, analytic and bit-interface obligations remain.

Credit dd-hemant PR816, woklerx PR961, Gareth Davidson PR964, ToikY PR909,
Adam Gall PR1220, Oscar Fennell PR759, Sricharan Vagvala PR749,
Ross Richardson PR932, and the retained supplier lineage. Prepared for Lauren
with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, code, proof and separate
AI review. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.

Scope is **unchanged**; publication status is independent corroboration of
PR1220. The seed22 assignment predates the current task-card workflow.
Publication overlap refresh retrieved all 811 open PRs over nine REST pages
(titles/bodies screened by CK/dyadic/Horner/forest keywords; not full code
review), and read the Discussion index and relevant #1163/#1166/#1167/#1210
threads. PR1220 remains the same-result overlap at its pinned head.
Discussion indexing/crawling and concurrent PR changes limit completeness.

**Open next questions: none justified by this corroboration.** See the package
README. The independent agreement supplies no new mechanism for reopening the
closed coefficient search; outside-class possibilities remain scope limits.
